findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_scene, open_in_editor, save_brand · Private data: render_mockup, render_scene, render_series, render_batch, open_in_editor, open_scene_in_editor, get_scene_video, refresh_scene_preview, capture_video, capture_url, add_images · Public sink: refresh_scene_preview, add_images, upload_image, save_design · Destructive: recommend_mockups, render_mockup, render_scene, render_series, open_scene_in_editor, capture_video, add_images, save_brand, save_design.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_scene, open_in_editor, save_brand · Private data: render_mockup, render_scene, render_series, render_batch, open_in_editor, open_scene_in_editor, get_scene_video, refresh_scene_preview, capture_video, capture_url, add_images · Public sink: refresh_scene_preview, add_images, upload_image, save_design · Destructive: recommend_mockups, render_mockup, render_scene, render_series, open_scene_in_editor, capture_video, add_images, save_brand, save_design

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
